about: The frozen bench world of the live tests of the agents. Paper makes it once from this seed in server-agents/bench/agentsbench, livetest.js keeps a pristine copy in server-agents/bench-pristine and restores it before every test, so every run starts from the same blocks at the same spot. The spot is found once by livetest.js bench_setup (the first flat grass spot on a square spiral around the world spawn) and written here.
